Full summary: Planned the response to field report 2026-09-04 items #3/#4 (cross-host sync, merge conflicts, old-Node ENOENT): docs/plans/2026-09-05-cross-host-sync-plan.md — DRAFT awaiting Dave's rulings; nothing implemented or sent
Decisions: [object Object]; [object Object]; [object Object]; [object Object]; [object Object]; [object Object]; [object Object]; [object Object]; [object Object]; [object Object]
Findings: twining_status dies at src/tools/lifecycle-tools.ts:60 (getIndex) one line before its own records_unread 'FELL BACK' warning at :128-132 can render — the one tool built to explain the old-Node fallback is in the failing set (V1 EXECUTED; control with index '[]' renders the warning first); warning: on a fallback host twining_record WITH decisions returns OK, writes the status post and the .last-record sentinel, and persists ZERO decisions — only decision_errors names it (src/tools/record-tools.ts:478-484); a session passes Gate 2 while losing every decision. housekeeping({}) returns fully green and search_decisions returns empty with fallback_mode:true in the same state; repairIndexDesync cannot recreate decisions/index.json when there are zero legacy decision files (early returns at src/storage/decision-store.ts:222-237 precede the ensureFileExists at :245), and `twining-mcp migrate` itself ENOENTs on such a store (src/migrate/forward.ts:127/168) — a pure sqlite-era clone on old Node is unrecoverable from inside Twining (V1 EXECUTED); override() with new_decision takes its D14 read-back at src/engine/decisions.ts:1096 BEFORE decide() at :1126-1137 flips the record to 'superseded' — the tool result echoes status 'overridden' while the store holds 'superseded'; test/decision-engine.test.ts:901-918 never asserts the old record (V4 EXECUTED); Entity upsert bumps updated_at on EVERY touch (src/storage/sqlite/sqlite-stores.ts:385) and re-exports the same ULID file — two hosts touching the same entity in one drain window conflict every time; graph auto-population makes this the highest-frequency same-record conflict, firing without any human lifecycle action (V5). Relation upserts are byte-stable when properties match; `git add .twining/records` stages atomic-write temp files <file>.<pid>.<rand>.tmp (src/storage/file-store.ts:62-65) — GITIGNORE_ENTRIES (src/storage/init.ts:20-33) has no *.tmp entry (correctness critic EXECUTED); `twining-mcp <any word other than migrate>` falls through src/index.ts:28-31 and STARTS A STDIO SERVER — a footgun for launchd jobs that try `twining-mcp drain` or `sync-status` (V6 EXECUTED); plain `git status` rewrites .git/index and takes index.lock (a concurrent `git add` fails rc=128 'index.lock: File exists'); `git --no-optional-locks status` is accurate and never writes; `git diff-index --quiet HEAD` reports 5,137 false 'M' after an mtime-only touch; `git push` changes ahead/behind while HEAD and FETCH_HEAD stay unchanged (V3 + critics EXECUTED); A 2.x point release is a plugin change by construction: `npm version` rebuilds plugin/server (package.json:21), the launcher execs the committed bundle first (plugin/scripts/launch-server.sh:7-13), CI requires a bump in both version files for any plugin/ diff (.github/workflows/ci.yml:14-49). No 2.x point release exists; v1.21.1/v1.24.1 are the precedents. scripts/measure-plugin-tokens.sh:24 counts only skills/agents — tool-description growth is unmeasured; The plugin pin does not pin the server for npx-rung hosts (launch-server.sh:42 PKG_SPEC twining-mcp@^2.0.0 floats); whether a release reaches the field depends on their launcher rung (`launch-server.sh --probe` prints runner=…) — asked as verification question #9; The W2 lineage wording already committed to the field (docs/field-responses/2026-08-23-wave2-verification-response.md:266 'rows where neither pointer resolves carry lineage_unresolved: true') would label every pure veto a lineage hole in 2.17.0; our Doc 2 :50 also wrote 'superseded_by: null' though nothing writes null (V4); FOUNDATION-PLAN D5 ('exports written into the originating worktree's checkout only') is not what ships either: RecordExporter writes under the resolved root, which for linked worktrees is the MAIN checkout (record-export.ts:63-65 + project-root.ts:86-91) — the place any drain must look (V6); need: Dave's §7 rulings (2.16.1 go/no-go + validator in/out; W2/2.17.1 split; DD-13 open/close; DD-6/11 routing; Doc 4 send timing; conservative AUTO-SAFE wording) before Workstream A or any breakdown starts; Verify agents left the live tree clean this session (git status: only .twining/records/posts untracked); this workflow's two worktrees held scratch repro tests, copied to the session scratchpad and then removed with their branches. Five older workflow worktrees from earlier sessions remain under .claude/worktrees and were not touched
